title: NodeDetailPanel — slide-out for step inspection
description:
When clicking a node in the DAG, a detail panel slides out from the right showing step-specific information. Different content per step type.

**File:** `dashboard/src/components/workflows/dag/NodeDetailPanel.tsx`

**For job steps:**
- Job ID (link to /jobs/:id), worker that executed it
- Safety decision with reason (from explain() output if available)
- Request payload (collapsible JSON viewer)
- Result payload (collapsible JSON viewer)
- Duration breakdown
- Error message if failed

**For approval steps:**
- Approval status (pending/approved/rejected)
- Who approved/rejected, when, their comment
- How long it was pending
- **If still pending: Approve/Reject buttons** (wired in next task)

**For condition steps:**
- Expression that was evaluated
- Result (true/false)
- Which branch was taken

**For delay steps:**
- Delay duration configured
- Time remaining (if in progress) or total wait (if completed)

**For fan-out steps:**
- Number of parallel branches
- Status of each branch

**Panel behavior:** Drawer component (reuse existing Drawer from ui/), slides from right, 400px wide. Close on X button or click outside. Shows step name and type in header.
definitionOfDone: NodeDetailPanel renders different content per step type
Job steps show safety decision, payloads, duration, error
Approval steps show status, actor, timing
Condition steps show expression, result, branch taken

implementationPlan.description:
Create `NodeDetailPanel` in `dashboard/src/components/workflows/dag/NodeDetailPanel.tsx`.

Uses existing `Drawer` from ui/. Width 400px, slides right. Header: step name (truncated 60 chars, text-only) + type badge + close X.

Props: `step` (definition), `runStep` (run state), `run`, `onClose`, `onApprove?`, `onReject?` callbacks.

Content per step type:
- **Job:** RunStatusBadge + duration, safety decision badge + reason, job ID link to /jobs/:id, worker ID, collapsible JSON request/result payloads (<pre> max 5000 chars), error card (red, truncated 500 chars)
- **Approval:** status badge, actor, comment, pending duration. Approve/Reject buttons rendered if callbacks provided AND status=waiting (disabled stubs here, wired in task-ee932549)
- **Condition:** expression in monospace, true/false result badge, branch taken
- **Delay:** configured duration, time remaining if running, total wait if completed
- **Fan-out:** parallelism value, forEach expression, child branch statuses

SECURITY: All strings via JSX text nodes (never innerHTML). JSON in <pre> text only. Job ID links validated with /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/. Error/payload strings truncated.
implementationPlan.note: Created NodeDetailPanel with per-step-type renderers: JobDetail (status, duration, job ID link, worker, safety decision badge+reason+evalTime, error card, collapsible JSON request/result), ApprovalDetail (status, actor, comment, pending duration, approve/reject buttons when waiting), ConditionDetail (expression, true/false badge, branch taken), DelayDetail (configured delay, elapsed/remaining), FanOutDetail (parallelism, forEach expression, child branch statuses), GenericDetail (notify + unknown types). Uses existing Drawer (size=sm), RunStatusBadge, Badge, Card. All text via JSX (no innerHTML), job ID validated with regex, strings truncated.
